description: This file defines a Supabase integration class for logging events and responses, including methods for input logging and event logging with cost and response time calculations.

classes.name: Supabase
classes.description: A class for logging events and responses to a Supabase database, handling both input and response logging with cost and timing metrics.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Supabase client with URL and key from environment variables, installing the 'supabase' package if necessary.

methods.name: input_log_event
methods.description: Logs an input event with model, messages, end user, and call ID to the Supabase table.

methods.name: log_event
methods.description: Logs a response event, including response time, cost, and success or error status, to the Supabase table.
